verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zulip publishes an API reference at zulip.com/api/ with per-endpoint pages such as 'Send a message', but nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable examples. Probes also found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
